title: Samsung OTA manifests — AP/CSC/CP for the full lineup
why: The manifest build string is a TRIPLET and the third field is the CP (modem) firmware version — the Android baseband column three agents concluded was unobtainable. CP diverges from AP on ~1/3 of builds, so it is not derivable from the build code. The asking box got 19 of 83 models before its daily per-host budget stopped it; this is the other 64, already collected.
control: SM-A055F/ILO must return a parseable <versioninfo>. A 403 from this host means 'no such model/CSC pair' (S3 AccessDenied, no ListBucket grant), NOT a block — DBT/SM-A055F 403s while DBT/SM-G991B returns 200 in the same second. The CONTROL is what separates those two, never the status code.
deliver: roms_latest.csv + samsung_modem.csv + result.json into relay/results/T005-fota-modem/. Raws NOT wanted: 1,660 files is a lot of repo for data we can re-fetch, and the CSVs plus SHA256SUMS are enough to verify. Keep the raws on your disk in case I ask.
expect: ~83 models x 20 CSCs. Many pairs legitimately do not exist (a model is not sold in every region) and those 403s are absences, not failures. Report the count of pairs that answered, not the count attempted.
access: Ray authorised this host explicitly after speaking with them. METADATA ONLY — version strings; the manifest also carries fwsize and a download path and neither is used. No firmware binary is ever fetched. No credentials.
